purpose: Teach: 和平/冥福/旺盛/平穏/献身/憎しみ/推論/分泌

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、和平交渉の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you were working on the history of peace negotiations for your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opener. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. A teacher checking in with genuine interest. Steady eye contact, encouraging posture.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦没者への冥福を願う行事を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on memorial services honoring those who died in war.
lines.style: Direct and clear, but soft underneath. Not defensive—just straightforward. The slight formality of a student speaking to a teacher she respects. Small pause before answering, as if choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 起業家の旺盛なご活躍を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you were working on the vigorous activities of entrepreneurs for your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly curious. A gentle contradiction coming—paced to give space for Sakura to correct. Warm, not testing. The tone of someone genuinely wondering what the student actually did.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、平穏な村社会の崩壊を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually focused on the collapse of peaceful village society.
lines.style: Composed correction, no apology in it. Steady voice. A student confident enough to redirect without flinching. Respectful but not cowed. The slight pause shows she's been expecting this.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医療従事者の献身を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You were exploring the dedication of healthcare workers for your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Attentive, leaning slightly forward. The rhythm slows—Asuka is genuinely tracking these patterns now. Still warm, but with a note of recognition. Not accusatory, just present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦争による憎しみの連鎖を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I explored how war creates cycles of hatred and resentment.
lines.style: Quiet and unwavering. No hesitation now. The subject matter carries weight—her voice doesn't flinch from it. A student who knows what she's been doing all along. Direct gaze held.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: AIによる推論モデルを論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you were working on AI reasoning models for your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Slower now. The pieces are landing. Asuka's tone has shifted—still warm, but with dawning understanding. A teacher who sees the pattern. Measured, reflective, almost thoughtful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ホルモン分泌の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I've been researching hormone secretion and biological responses.
lines.style: Final statement, measured and complete. No defensive edge, but full of quiet conviction. The formality softens into something more grounded. A pause at the end—letting the pattern speak for itself.
